commentary:
Graded the two system walks entry by entry over each entry's file, its applied ripples and its sweep scope, then listed the files changed since the external return's commit: README.md, docs/getting-started.md, docs/workflows.md, start-sections.test.ts and user-docs.ts, each inside some entry's edit record, so the residual check finds no unrecorded edit.

The claim most worth probing was the new Step by step sentence, which points readers at a hand-written `architecture: {doc, stage}` key: the change-metadata schema declares the field valid in change metadata (src/core/artifact-graph/types.ts:155-173) and the stage-state reader counts a well-shaped one on an active change (src/core/architecture/state.ts:81-88, 138), so the route the docs name is one the engine reads. Getting-started's step 0 now attributes the citation to the exploration's offer and propose's carry, which matches orbit-explore's body (the offer) and orbit-propose's merge (the staged architecture: field carried forward).

The level match was shown red under a title-only mutation and the inventory pin red with one member dropped; both test edits keep the scenario tags they carried. One edge the fresh finding named stays as it was and no walk entry claimed it: two headings with the same text and level on one page still resolve to the first. No listed page has such a pair today.

Pass 0 (verify-change) and Pass 6 (audit-drift) cover the whole change and the whole project and are not run by a pass that verifies walks; Passes 4 and 5 have no lens files to read.

verification.title: Getting-started's step 1 says skip explore, but only the exploration records the stage citation step 0 promises
The start-sections check finds a listed heading by its text alone, not its level
README says explore alone starts the change; the other pages say propose starts it
Explicitly skip stage ratification on the one-off path
